How do I update my contact or account details?

Sent · Just now

NOBULL Digital Assistant · AI

NOBULL Digital Assistant · AI says:

You can update several parts of your NOBULL account and subscription from your account area:

Shipping address for your subscription: Log in, go to Manage Subscription, click Edit next to Shipping Information, update your address, and save.
Payment method for your subscription: Log in, go to Manage Subscription, click Edit next to Billing, and update or add a payment method. You can also set a primary card.
Other subscription details: In Manage Subscription, you can edit or skip a delivery, pause or cancel your subscription, change delivery frequency, and update shipping or payment info. Changes must be made before your next scheduled shipment.
Email preferences: Manage marketing email preferences or unsubscribe from NOBULL marketing emails in your account. For SMS, reply STOP to opt out.
Email address: Email changes are not supported. For security, you’ll need to create a new account with the correct email address.

If you meant a different contact detail, sign in and check My Account or Manage Subscription for the specific field you want to update.
